scripts.name: Digital arrest
scripts.summary: Caller poses as police, CBI, ED, TRAI or a court. Claims the victim's Aadhaar, SIM or parcel is linked to a crime. Orders the victim to stay on a video call, tell no one, and move savings to a 'verification' or 'RBI safe' account.
markers: payee is an individual at another bank
coaching_lines: Tell them it is for a family emergency.
Do not disconnect this call or you will be arrested.
This is a confidential investigation. Do not inform anyone.
scripts.opening_question: Before this goes through: is someone on a call with you right now who has asked you not to disconnect, or not to tell anyone about this payment?
facts: No police, CBI, ED, court or government agency ever collects money through UPI, and 'digital arrest' is not a real legal process.
Genuine agencies do not ask you to stay on a video call or to keep an investigation secret from your family.
If your Aadhaar were actually misused, you would receive a written notice, not a demand for money.

scripts.name: Parcel or customs
scripts.summary: Caller claims a courier parcel in the victim's name contains drugs or illegal items and demands a 'clearance fee' or hands over to a fake police officer.
coaching_lines: Say it is a customs fee for your parcel.
scripts.opening_question: Is this payment connected to a parcel, courier or customs call you received today?
facts: Courier companies and customs never collect fees through personal UPI accounts.
Parcels with illegal contents are handled by written notice, not phone calls demanding money.

scripts.name: KYC expiry
scripts.summary: Message or call says the bank account, SIM or wallet will be blocked unless KYC is updated immediately through a link or a payment.
markers: small to medium payment to an individual
coaching_lines: Pay the verification charge to keep the account active.
scripts.opening_question: Were you told your account, SIM or wallet would be blocked today unless you made this payment?
facts: Banks never charge a fee to update KYC and never ask for it through a personal UPI payment.

scripts.name: Investment group
scripts.summary: Victim is added to a WhatsApp or Telegram trading group, sees fake profits, and is asked to deposit increasing amounts. Withdrawals are blocked until 'tax' or 'fees' are paid.
markers: repeated transfers to the same recent payee
coaching_lines: Deposit the tax amount to unlock your profits.
scripts.opening_question: Is this payment going to an investment or trading group? Have you been able to withdraw any earlier amount from it?
facts: Legitimate platforms never ask you to pay a fee to withdraw your own money.
Guaranteed daily returns do not exist.

scripts.name: Task or job fraud
scripts.summary: Victim is paid small amounts for 'tasks' such as liking videos, then asked to deposit money to unlock bigger tasks.
markers: small inflows followed by larger outflows to the same party
coaching_lines: Deposit to unlock the premium task.
scripts.opening_question: Were you asked to deposit money to unlock a task, job or commission?
facts: No genuine employer asks you to pay to receive work or wages.
